note: Replaces the safeStringify comparison of cached vs current flag filters with objectsEqual and drops the safeStringify import.
Remodels autonomy config into per-user self-scoped configs, removing the OrganizationMembership-based user validation entirely; no User.teams check is added.
Deletes the local key normalizers and imports normalizeProviderKey from provider-matching, wrapping it in a small endpointProviderKey helper.
Removes hand-rolled role/aria/keyboard handling on LemonTag and makes LemonSwitch the real control with onChange, label, disabledReason and aria-label.
Keeps the cohort-level persisted reducer but adds a pointer to columnConfiguratorLogic, an explicit team-scoped storageKey, and moves restore into a selector.
Keeps the separate person chunk-scan metric and adds a doc comment justifying it; also adds a MetricTimer RAII helper. No kind label added.
Only changes the raw button's color classes to warning CSS variables for light mode; still a raw button, not LemonButton.
Adds a generic CoercedStringListField with overridable error message and max_items to posthog/api/fields.py and subclasses it for the unset keys field.
Introduces ACTIVITY_EVENTS_DEFAULT_DATE_FROM constant and uses it in all three places that hardcoded the -24h fallback.
Renames the feedback-submit MCP tool to agent-feedback in the tool map, schemas, templates and tests.
Removes summary, hypotheses, recommendations and tool call count from the signal extra metadata; also drops verdict weights.
Moves the steps directory under ingestion/common/steps and updates all imports across pipelines.
Adds bounded retry and notFound/retries state for fingerprint resolution; the raw-path decoding in paramsToProps is left in place.
Replaces the inline resolved-label guard with withResolvedFlagLabels and adds a test case.
Splits config into CookielessManagerConfig and a server config adding Redis keys, and uses the manager config type in the constructor.
Moves the real error tracking signal fixture into products/signals/eval/fixtures.
Splits schedules into separate CRUD endpoints, drops scheduled runs and adds next_run_at; starts_at remains a separate field, not folded into rrule dtstart.
Extracts a shared unreadable closure for CaBundleUnreadable and uses it for both the iterator and per-certificate errors.
Replaces direct posthog.capture calls with eventUsageLogic report actions for wizard sync detected, finished and dismissed events.
Only updates the module docstring about HTTP reads being side-effect free; the query still uses all_teams.filter(team_id=...), not for_team.
